about: One record per vendor (business or organization paid by a Bay County government, CRA or tourism agency). aliases are every spelling found in contracts, change orders, emergency purchases, check registers (including 15-character truncations), TDC payments, the CRA ledger and business campaign contributions. Built by data/entities/build_entities.py; hand-reviewed joins carry merge_evidence. Look-alike names that were not joined are in vendor_review.json.
